contentBlocks.body: Parameters are local names for inputs passed into a function. Choose parameter names that describe what the function needs.
**Worked example.** Parameters are local names matched to arguments by position. This call binds name to Pens and count to 3. A second call gets its own bindings, so no global variable is needed.
Swapping arguments changes their meaning even when JavaScript allows both values.

**Try a small change.** Predict label(3, 'Pens'). How could an object argument make this contract clearer?

Then complete the independent check below without copying the example. Explain the boundary case in words before running it.
